Package com.sicomsa.dmt

Interface ExtendedQuery

All Superinterfaces:
Query, Serializable
All Known Implementing Classes:
ExtendedQueryMap
public interface ExtendedQuery extends Query
Represents a query to be submitted to the web service within the request download service; it contains methods needed to implement the web service version 1.5, releases May 30, 2025 by SAT.
